planets.name: TOI-2095 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2095 with a 17.7-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2095 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2095. Its orbit and size follow Murgas et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
